mapper.sql: SELECT version_id, biz_type, biz_id, version_no, version_desc, effective_flag, effective_time, invalid_time, effect_basis, effect_ref, is_final_set, file_url, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM pdm_doc_version
mapper.select: WHERE biz_type = #{bizType} AND biz_id = #{bizId} AND effective_flag = '1' LIMIT 1
WHERE biz_type = #{bizType} AND biz_id = #{bizId} ORDER BY version_id DESC LIMIT 1

WHERE (biz_type = '1' AND biz_id IN (SELECT scheme_id FROM pdm_scheme WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND del_flag = '0')) OR (biz_type = '2' AND biz_id IN (SELECT file_id FROM pdm_design_file WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND del_flag = '0')) OR (biz_type = '3' AND biz_id IN (SELECT bom_id FROM pdm_design_bom WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND del_flag = '0')) ORDER BY version_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pdm_doc_version (biz_type, biz_id, version_no, version_desc, effective_flag, effective_time, invalid_time, effect_basis, effect_ref, is_final_set, file_url, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{versionNo}, #{versionDesc}, #{effectiveFlag}, #{effectiveTime}, #{invalidTime}, #{effectBasis}, #{effectRef}, #{isFinalSet}, #{fileUrl}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM pdm_doc_version WHERE version_id IN #{versionId}
